**Subject:** RE: A21070614// Need AMC quote || TSITRB15102020-QB133 - Following Up on Our Opportunity  

Dear Rimpy,  

Thank you again for the opportunity to collaborate on the recent BOQ—we truly enjoyed working together and are excited about the potential to support your needs in Brazil, especially given our full import/export licensing capabilities.  

Since we last connected, Zion Tech Group has refined our offerings to better serve partners like Techsub. Here are three strategic directions that could add immediate value:  

1. **Integrated AMC + Remote Support Model** – We can provide a seamless blend of parts supply and remote technical support, leveraging our local infrastructure in Brazil to reduce downtime and improve response SLAs. This would include on-call engineering coverage and preventive maintenance protocols tailored to your client’s environment.  

2. **Co-Developed AI Readiness Assessment Package** – Building on our prior discussions, we propose packaging the AI audit framework into a scalable, white-labeled service that Techsub can offer to clients. We bring the technical depth; you lead with trusted client relationships. Revenue sharing on net margin would apply.  

3. **Hybrid Cloud Migration & AI Ops Pilot** – A short-term engagement to migrate select workloads to a hybrid model while integrating AI-driven operations monitoring. The goal: measurable improvements in system uptime and operational efficiency, with clear ROI metrics before any long-term commitment.  

Let’s find the best way forward—whether refining terms over email or jumping on a quick call. My schedule is open this week:  
👉 [https://calendly.com/kleber-ziontechgroup](https://calendly.com/kleber-ziontechgroup)  

In the meantime, feel free to explore our free digital tools and resources at [https://ziontechgroup.com](https://ziontechgroup.com)—they’re designed to help teams like yours accelerate planning and decision-making.  

Looking forward to your thoughts on which direction makes the most sense for Techsub.  

Warm regards,
